name: Folder Card
summary: Document-collection card shaped like a file folder with a peeking sheet, duotone icon, view count and a tinted corner watermark.
useWhen: Browsing collections of documents, codes or laws as a grid with view counts
Category landing pages where each tile opens a document set
avoidWhen: Listing individual files with sizes and actions, where workspace/files-04 fits better
Dense tables or lists that need many columns
source: Original; idea from a law-code collection UI
